texts.preamble: Satya Prakash vs State Of U.P. And Another on 25 August, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:146602 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 31571 of 2025 Court No. - 89 Hon'Ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha, J.
texts.arguments: 3. It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that the case under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is of the year 2007, in which, the applicant is an accused. He further submits that the accused kept on attending the learned trial Court regularly but due to Covid-19, he was under the impression that his case was withdrawn by the prosecution and under this misconception, he could not appear before the learned trial Court and a non bailable warrant was issued on 07.12.2021. He prays that the order issuing non bailable warrant is [LEAKAGE_MASK]. 4. On the other hand learned AGA submits that due to non appearance of the applicant on several dates, the leaned trial Court proceeded to issue non bailable warrant against the applicant.
